title: Business Travel
ringkas: Bandara, hotel, transportasi, dan menjamu rekan
goals: memakai bahasa Inggris di **bandara**: check-in, keamanan, boarding, dan bagasi
memesan, check-in, dan check-out **hotel**, serta meminta layanan
bertanya arah dan memakai **transportasi** (taksi, kereta, kendaraan daring)
menjamu rekan kerja dari luar negeri: menjemput, menawarkan makan, dan mengantar
membuat dan membahas **itinerary** (jadwal perjalanan) serta pengeluaran dinas
menangani masalah perjalanan: penundaan, bagasi hilang, dan perubahan jadwal

lesson.text: Perjalanan dinas melibatkan banyak percakapan singkat: di bandara, hotel, taksi, dan restoran. Dengan kalimat yang tepat, perjalananmu lebih lancar dan kamu tampil profesional. Kamu juga akan belajar menyambut rekan dari luar negeri.

lesson.title: Sopan santun lintas budaya
lesson.text: Jabat tangan yang tegas dan kontak mata umum di banyak negara, tetapi kebiasaan berbeda-beda. Datanglah **tepat waktu**, ucapkan **please** dan **thank you**, dan jika ragu, tanyakan dengan sopan: [[Is it okay if I ...?]]

lines.en: Good morning. I'd like to check in for the flight to Singapore.
lines.id: Selamat pagi. Saya ingin check-in untuk penerbangan ke Singapura.

lines.en: Certainly. May I see your passport and e-ticket, please?
lines.id: Tentu. Boleh saya lihat paspor dan tiket elektronik Anda?

lines.en: Here you are. Could I have a window seat, please?
lines.id: Ini. Bolehkah saya dapat kursi dekat jendela?

lines.en: Sure. Do you have any bags to check in?
lines.id: Tentu. Apakah Anda punya bagasi untuk dititipkan?

lines.en: Just this one. And this is my carry-on.
lines.id: Hanya yang ini. Dan ini bagasi kabin saya.

lines.en: Here is your boarding pass. Boarding starts at 9:30 at Gate 12.
lines.id: Ini kartu naik Anda. Boarding dimulai pukul 9:30 di Gerbang 12.

lines.en: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Putri.
lines.id: Selamat malam. Saya punya pemesanan atas nama Putri.

lines.en: Yes, Ms. Putri. A single room for two nights. May I see your passport?
lines.id: Ya, Ibu Putri. Satu kamar single untuk dua malam. Boleh saya lihat paspor Anda?

lines.en: Of course. Is breakfast included, and what time is check-out?
lines.id: Tentu. Apakah sarapan termasuk, dan pukul berapa check-out?

lines.en: Breakfast is included from 6 to 10. Check-out is at noon. Your room is 508.
lines.id: Sarapan termasuk dari pukul 6 sampai 10. Check-out pukul dua belas siang. Kamar Anda 508.

lines.en: Thank you. Could you send someone to fix the air conditioner? It isn't working.
lines.id: Terima kasih. Bisakah Anda mengirim orang untuk memperbaiki AC? Tidak berfungsi.

lesson.title: Dialog 3: Menyambut tamu dari luar negeri

lines.en: Welcome to Jakarta, Mr. Smith! Did you have a good flight?
lines.id: Selamat datang di Jakarta, Pak Smith! Apakah penerbangan Anda menyenangkan?

lines.en: Yes, thank you. It was long, but comfortable. I have a little jet lag.
lines.id: Ya, terima kasih. Lama, tetapi nyaman. Saya sedikit jet lag.

lines.en: Let me help you with your luggage. My driver is waiting outside.
lines.id: Biar saya bantu membawa bagasi Anda. Sopir saya menunggu di luar.

lines.en: Tomorrow the meeting starts at 9. I'll pick you up at 8:30. Please let me know if you need anything.
lines.id: Besok rapat dimulai pukul 9. Saya akan menjemput Anda pukul 8:30. Beri tahu saya jika Anda butuh sesuatu.

Sarapan disajikan pukul 06.30 sampai 10.00 di restoran lantai dasar. Waktu check-out pukul 12.00 siang. Ini kunci kartunya. Tamu: Terima kasih. Bisakah saya mendapat panggilan pagi pukul enam besok?

read.text:
Receptionist: Good evening. Welcome to Grand Mulia Hotel. Do you have a reservation?
Guest: Yes, under the name Anwar Santoso. I booked a single room for three nights. Receptionist: Let me check. Yes, Mr. Santoso, room 805 on the eighth floor. Breakfast is served from 6.30 to 10.00 in the restaurant on the ground floor. Check-out time is 12.00 noon. Here is your key card. Guest: Thank you. Could I get a wake-up call at six tomorrow?

read.id:
Hari 1 (Senin): Penerbangan GA 410 berangkat dari Jakarta pukul 07.00 dan tiba di Singapura pukul 09.50. Check-in di hotel, lalu menghadiri rapat klien pukul 14.00. Makan malam dengan tim Singapura pukul 19.00.
Hari 2 (Selasa): Presentasi di kantor klien pukul 10.00, dilanjutkan kunjungan pabrik. Hari 3 (Rabu): Pagi bebas untuk berbelanja. Penerbangan pulang pukul 15.30 dan mendarat di Jakarta pukul 16.20. Mobil perusahaan akan menjemput Anda di bandara.

read.text:
Day 1 (Monday): Flight GA 410 departs Jakarta at 7.00 a.m. and arrives in Singapore at 9.50 a.m. Check in at the hotel, then attend a client meeting at 2.00 p.m. Dinner with the Singapore team at 7.00 p.m.
Day 2 (Tuesday): Presentation at the client's office at 10.00 a.m., followed by a factory visit. Day 3 (Wednesday): Free morning for shopping. Flight returns at 3.30 p.m. and lands in Jakarta at 4.20 p.m. A company car will pick you up at the airport.

read.focus: Going to, will, dan present simple untuk perjalanan
read.id:
Minggu depan, aku akan terbang ke Singapura untuk rapat dengan klien. Penerbanganku berangkat pukul 7.00 hari Senin pagi, dan tiba pukul 9.50. Seorang rekan akan menjemputku di bandara, dan kami akan langsung ke kantor klien.
Aku sudah memesan hotel dekat kantor. Hotelnya kecil, tetapi menyediakan sarapan gratis. Penerbangan pulang berangkat hari Rabu pukul 3.30, jadi aku akan tiba kembali di Jakarta pada malam hari. Jika penerbangan tertunda, aku akan segera menelepon kantor.

read.text:
Next week, I am going to fly to Singapore for a client meeting. My flight leaves at 7.00 on Monday morning, and it arrives at 9.50. A colleague will pick me up at the airport, and we will go straight to the client's office.
I have already booked a hotel near the office. It's a small hotel, but it has free breakfast. The return flight departs on Wednesday at 3.30, so I will arrive back in Jakarta in the evening. If the flight is delayed, I will call the office immediately.
read.title: A Business Trip

read.focus: Perjalanan: kalimat if dan time clauses (when, as soon as, before)
read.id:
Ana akan bepergian ke Tokyo untuk konferensi. Sebelum berangkat, dia akan check-in secara daring. Ketika tiba di bandara, dia akan menitipkan bagasi di konter. Begitu melewati pemeriksaan keamanan, dia akan menelepon manajernya.
Jika penerbangan tertunda, dia akan menunggu di lounge. Ketika mendarat di Tokyo, dia akan naik taksi ke hotel. Jika punya waktu, dia akan mengunjungi sebuah kuil sebelum konferensi dimulai. Dia tidak akan meninggalkan hotel sampai dia menyelesaikan slide-nya.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan present simple setelah when:
qs.q: When she ___ (arrive) at the airport, she will drop her luggage.
If the flight is delayed, she ___ wait in the lounge.

qs.answer: She won't leave the hotel until she has finished her slides.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia tidak akan meninggalkan hotel sampai dia menyelesaikan slide-nya."

read.text:
Ana is going to travel to Tokyo for a conference. Before she leaves, she will check in online. When she arrives at the airport, she will drop her luggage at the counter. As soon as she passes security, she will call her manager.
If the flight is delayed, she will wait in the lounge. When she lands in Tokyo, she will take a taxi to the hotel. If she has time, she will visit a temple before the conference starts. She won't leave the hotel until she has finished her slides.
read.title: Before the Flight

read.text:
Guest: Excuse me, could you tell me what time breakfast is served? Receptionist: It's served from six thirty to ten. Guest: Would you mind telling me where the restaurant is? Receptionist: It's on the ground floor, next to the lobby.
Guest: I was wondering whether I could have a late check-out. Receptionist: I'll check if that is possible. Would two o'clock be convenient? Guest: That would be perfect. Could you also arrange a taxi for tomorrow morning? Receptionist: Certainly. What time would you like it?

Ana: Kami mendarat di bandara pukul dua belas siang. Itu penerbangan panjang, dan aku tidur di pesawat. Lalu kami naik taksi dari bandara ke hotel. Kami menginap di hotel dekat stasiun selama dua malam.
Daniel: Apakah kalian check-in di meja depan? Ana: Ya. Kamar kami di lantai enam, dengan pemandangan sungai. Pada malam hari, kami makan malam di restoran di sudut jalan. Besok, kami akan ke kantor klien naik metro.

read.text:
Ana: We landed at the airport at noon. It was a long flight, and I slept on the plane. Then we took a taxi from the airport to the hotel. We stayed in a hotel near the station for two nights.
Daniel: Did you check in at the front desk? Ana: Yes, we did. Our room is on the sixth floor, with a view of the river. In the evening, we had dinner at a restaurant on the corner. Tomorrow, we'll go to the client's office by metro.

qs.answer: I booked a room at a hotel near the station.

read.text:
Ana: I have a flight to Singapore tomorrow. The flight leaves at seven, so I must be at the airport at five. I booked a room at a hotel near the station. The hotel offers a free shuttle.
Daniel: That is an easy way to travel. Do you have an umbrella? It rains a lot there. Ana: Yes, I packed an umbrella and a jacket. I will take the shuttle to the hotel, and then I'll have dinner. Daniel: Have a safe trip!
